maxillary_keypoint_topology.keypoint_spatial_matrix: Four primary high-contrast spots arranged in a near-linear horizontal row above the main vibrissae cluster, approximately 15 pixels superior to the primary dense row.

rhinarium_pixel_ratio.melanin_saturation_percentage: Approximately 95% dark/black melanin saturation on the visible lateral surface of the rhinarium apex; minimal pink-tone pixels detected.

cranial_profile_vector.frontal_slope_angle: Continuous concave slope descending from the superior orbital ridge to the nasal tip at approximately a 30-degree angle relative to the horizontal maxillary plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple small dark punctate lesions or temporal marks visible on the frontal bone area above the eye; minor irregular notch on the superior-posterior edge of the right pinna.
other_distinctive_markers: Dark pigmented 'tear-mark' extending from the anterior canthus toward the muzzle; prominent black pigmentation on the dorsal-distal margin of the ear.
